title: Storm of Steel
description: Discard your Hand. Add 1 Shiv into your Hand for each card discarded.
upgraded_description: Discard your Hand. Add 1 Shiv+ into your Hand for each card discarded.
notes: Creates a number of Shiv cards equal to the number of cards discarded from hand. If upgraded, the created Shivs are upgraded versions (Shiv+).
